harper (docs): Quick PR incoming to update the model catalog cards for a few new quantized builds and to fix a couple of broken links. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5012

devin (ml): I'll drop the vetted perf rows shortly. Short summary: mistral-7b-q4_0 -> runtime-accepted 32k, ~9.2 tok/ms on p4d-8x (batch=1); llama3-8b -> trained 16k, runtime accepts 32k (soft-truncate after ~20k).

kai (eng): FYI for Dedicated/Private: older agent images (pre-2024-10) won't load q5 artifacts. Add migration note and this command:

```
rwctl agents upgrade --image=redwood/runtime:rwinf-2024.10
```

Also call out per-shard KV cache limit = 48GB. Rolling upgrades preserve sessions but KV cache flush needed on shard swaps.

harper (docs): Thanks — I'll add the migration snippet and a compatibility table with columns: trained vs runtime-supported vs behavior.

anya (product): Please include a concise "recommended for" line on each card and keep top-level benchmark numbers rounded. Exact CSVs can be in the expandable section. Marketing happy. :+1:

devin (ml): I uploaded raw CSVs to s3://redwood-bench/mistral7b/2025-03-12.csv and added the link in the PR comment. Also: mark q5_1 as "lab-tested" and not enabled for auto-quantize by default.

link-checker-bot: [auto] found one broken vendor URL on the llama3 card; suggested replacement: https://vendor.example/llama3/info

harper (docs): I'll add python + curl snippets (streaming + non-streaming) and a tiny smoke test under docs/examples/smoke/ to validate the non-streaming snippet returns text. Anyone want to paste a short snippet?

devin (ml): Python non-streaming: `from redwood import RedwoodClient
rc = RedwoodClient(api_key=os.getenv('REDWOOD_KEY'))
resp = rc.generate(model='mistral-7b-q4_0', input='Explain prefix caching', max_tokens=64)
print(resp.text)`

harper (docs): Perfect, will include. Merging after CI and infra signoff. Ping me on the PR for any last comments. :sparkles:
